Body.Content:
Organizations operating across different regions need to record mileage expenses using the units of measure appropriate for their employees and local requirements. Dynamics 365 Project Operations will support kilometers (km) as a configurable unit of measure for mileage expenses, in addition to miles. Organizations can configure the appropriate mileage unit for their business, helping employees record mileage expenses accurately using the measurement standard relevant to their regional requirements.

GA date: December CY2026
